paragraphs: Leo got an email from his pen pal Ravi on Friday evening. The subject was "My house." Ravi sent a plan of the two floors, too. "Hi Leo, Thank you for your tiger card. It is on my wall now. Here is my house, from the front door to the garden.

Our house has two floors. On the ground floor, there is a living room and a kitchen. The living room has a low table, and Grandpa's chess board is on it. Grandpa and I play chess there every Sunday. I have never won, because I can't take his king. Next to the board, there is a book with Grandpa's stamps. He has stamps from many countries. Mom reads her book on the sofa while we play. Grandpa has a chair by the window, and he drinks tea there. The kitchen is small, but I love it. Dad and I cook there on Saturday. We made a big bowl of soup last week. It was delicious.

My bedroom is on the top floor, next to the bathroom. My little sister sleeps after lunch, so we whisper in the hall. In the bathroom, there is a plastic bottle of shampoo on the shelf. I have a bed, a desk, and a big window in my room. My bed is next to the window, and I can see the garden. Your card is on the wall above my desk. Behind the house, there is a small garden with two trees. We sit there in the evening and drink cold water. My sister plays there with her ball. I like my home because it is quiet.
Do you have a garden at your house? What is in your living room? Have you ever played chess? Please send me a plan of your house, too. Best wishes, Ravi"
text.summary: Leo gets an email from his pen pal Ravi. Ravi tells Leo about his house, from the living room and the kitchen to his bedroom and the garden.
